name: Form Header Section
description: A responsive row of labeled fields (mix of text/number/date/lookup), the standard shape for a document header entry area. Wrap the whole section in molecule.dynamic-style-by-pagemode if it should become read-only in view mode, or individual fields in molecule.conditional-visibility if specific fields should be mode-dependent.

fields.description: List of { xs, md, lg, fieldMolecule } — fieldMolecule is one of molecules/field-*.json with its params filled in.
